crossRefs.note: When he had said these words, the Jews departed, having a great dispute among themselves.
You hypocrites! Well did Isaiah prophesy of you, saying,
He answered them, “Well did Isaiah prophesy of you hypocrites, as it is written, ‘This people honors me with their…
For no prophecy ever came by the will of man: but holy men of God spoke, being moved by the Holy Spirit.

people.name: Isaiah
people.line: Prophet during reigns of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, Hezekiah.

people.name: Paul
people.line: Apostle to the Gentiles, author of many NT epistles

translations.web: When they didn’t agree among themselves, they departed after Paul had spoken one word, “The Holy Spirit spoke rightly through Isaiah the prophet to our fathers,
translations.bsb: They disagreed among themselves and began to leave after Paul had made this final statement: “The Holy Spirit was right when He spoke to your fathers through Isaiah the prophet:
translations.kjv: And when they agreed not among themselves, they departed, after that Paul had spoken one word, Well spake the Holy Ghost by Esaias the prophet unto our fathers,
translations.asv: And when they agreed not among themselves, they departed after that Paul had spoken one word, Well spake the Holy Spirit through Isaiah the prophet unto your fathers,
